sentences.text: A propeller does more than push.
Its blades also push the stern sideways, called propeller walk or prop walk.

On a single-screw boat with a right-hand propeller, which turns clockwise when viewed from astern going ahead, the stern kicks slightly to starboard going ahead and walks strongly to port going astern.
That’s why many single-screw captains prefer to dock port side to: a burst of reverse to stop the boat also pulls the stern in toward the dock.
Learn which way your boat walks before you need it.
